summary: Iteration-4 targeted retest of the 4 fixes reported in iteration_3.json. Backend: re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py -> 19/19 PASSED (previously 17/19; both known failures now fixed) and added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (5 new regression cases, all PASSED) covering totals persistence across PUT/GET/list and profit-report date validation. No new bugs; only 2 cosmetic nits remain.

minor.issue: FIXED & VERIFIED: parts_total/grand_total now recomputed from merged doc and persisted in $set. Verified 21.00 part + labor 40 -> 61.00 in PUT response, GET /repairs/{id} and GET /repairs; re-editing labor to 10 -> 31.00; unrelated field update keeps totals intact.
FIXED & VERIFIED: start=not-a-date, end=13/45/2026 and start=2026-02-30 all return 400 with detail exactly 'Invalid date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.'; valid ranges still 200.
STILL OPEN (pre-existing, low priority): multi-collection writes are not atomic / no rollback.

ui_bugs.issue: Trash icon is absolutely positioned at bottom-3 right-3 and visually overlaps/crowds the card's Total amount on hover (icon sits on top of the '€' glyph). Cosmetic only; suggest shifting the Total value left (pr-8) or moving the trash to the card header.
STILL OPEN: Radix warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on both dialogs (a11y).

issues: STILL OPEN (optional): FROM/TO still use native <input type=date> pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere.

action_items: Nothing blocking. Optional polish: (1) keep the trash icon from overlapping the card Total, (2) add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the two Repairs dialogs, (3) swap Profit-tab native date inputs for the shadcn Calendar.

Housekeeping: leftover test data still pollutes the app — job card JOB-260820-1F40 ('TEST_Customer QA', Toyota Corolla, TEST-123, in_progress, 1 part / 50,00 EUR) and orphaned TEST_ OUT transactions that still appear in the Profit report ('TEST_Brake Pad' under category General, since its inventory item was deleted). Consider cleaning db.repairs/db.transactions of TEST_ rows before delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: update_repair() fix is correct (merge card+updates -> _recalc_repair -> persist both totals); no divergence between response and DB anymore.
report_profit() try/except only wraps fromisoformat — good; consider a shared date-parse dependency since other report endpoints may take date params.
server.py is still ~1065 lines; splitting repairs/POs/invoices/reports into routers remains advisable.

Profit report cost fallback uses current inventory cost_price when txn.item_cost is missing and silently uses 0 for deleted items — orphaned TEST_ txns therefore inflate profit/margin; consider excluding txns whose item no longer exists or persisting item_cost/category on every OUT txn.
